caesar-besieged-alexandria.research_focus: late Roman Republic legionary equipment, Ptolemaic Alexandria's palace quarter and harbour
caesar-besieged-alexandria.scene: Roman legionaries with large curved shields holding a barricade of timber and rubble across a colonnaded palace street, a commander in a general's cloak pointing toward the harbour where ships burn; the commander is seen from behind

rome-annexes-egypt.research_focus: Roman officers and legionaries of the late 1st century BCE, Ptolemaic temple pylons and Nile grain barges
rome-annexes-egypt.scene: A young Roman commander in a cuirass standing on the steps of an Egyptian temple pylon while legionaries plant a legionary eagle standard beside him, grain barges moored on the Nile below; no queen and no snake

portugal-captures-ceuta.research_focus: early 15th-century Portuguese men-at-arms and ships, Marinid-era North African port walls
portugal-captures-ceuta.scene: Portuguese men-at-arms in plate and mail wading ashore from ship's boats and rushing an open gate in a walled North African port, round-hulled ships crowding the strait behind them

da-gama-sails-round-africa.research_focus: 1490s Portuguese naus and caravels, crew dress, the Cape of Good Hope coastline
da-gama-sails-round-africa.scene: Four small Portuguese sailing ships heeling in heavy swell past a towering rocky cape, sailors hauling on ropes on the nearest deck; the sails carry a plain cross and no lettering

alcacer-quibir-sebastian-dies.research_focus: 1570s Portuguese royal armour and infantry, Saadian Moroccan cavalry
alcacer-quibir-sebastian-dies.scene: A young king in gilded plate armour on a rearing horse, sword raised, surrounded on a dusty plain by wheeling Moroccan light cavalry as his foot soldiers break behind him; he is still mounted and unwounded, with no bodies shown

mungo-park-reaches-niger.research_focus: 1790s European traveller's dress, the Niger at Segou with Bambara canoes and mud-brick town
mungo-park-reaches-niger.scene: A gaunt, ragged traveller in a worn coat and tall hat kneeling at the bank of a very wide river to drink, long dugout canoes ferrying people across and a mud-brick town on the far shore

boers-win-blood-river.research_focus: 1830s Voortrekker ox-wagons, dress and muzzle-loading guns; Zulu regiments with cowhide shields and short spears
boers-win-blood-river.scene: Bearded farmers in wide-brimmed hats firing muzzle-loaders from between ox-wagons drawn up in a tight ring beside a river, a great mass of Zulu warriors with tall cowhide shields charging across the grass; no fallen bodies in the foreground

livingstone-sees-victoria-falls.research_focus: 1850s explorer's dress and peaked cap, Makololo paddlers and dugout canoes, Victoria Falls from the island at its lip
livingstone-sees-victoria-falls.scene: A European explorer in a peaked cap lying flat at the edge of a rocky island to peer over the lip of an immense waterfall, columns of spray rising high above, his African paddlers steadying a dugout canoe behind him

british-storm-magdala.research_focus: 1868 British and Indian army uniforms, elephants carrying mountain guns, the Magdala plateau fortress
british-storm-magdala.scene: British and Indian soldiers climbing a steep rocky path toward the wooden gate of a fortress on a flat-topped mountain, an elephant carrying a dismantled cannon on the track below; the emperor is not shown

italy-invades-libya.research_focus: 1911 Italian naval infantry uniforms and warships, Tripoli's waterfront fort and minarets
italy-invades-libya.scene: Italian sailors and soldiers with rifles jumping from rowing boats onto a stone quay beneath an old harbour fort, steel warships with smoking funnels anchored offshore and minarets on the skyline

treaty-of-fez-morocco.research_focus: 1912 Moroccan palace interiors in Fez, zellij tilework, carved cedar, a diplomatic writing set
treaty-of-fez-morocco.scene: A low table in a tiled Moroccan palace courtyard holding an unrolled treaty, a pen in its stand and a wax seal, with a French officer's kepi and gloves set down beside a sultan's empty cushioned seat; no people, and the document is blank-faced

rif-rout-spain-annual.research_focus: 1921 Rif tribesmen's djellabas, turbans and rifles; Spanish army field camps and equipment in the Rif mountains
rif-rout-spain-annual.scene: Rif fighters in hooded djellabas with rifles streaming down a bare mountain ridge into an abandoned Spanish hilltop camp of sandbags, tents and an overturned field gun; the fighters are anonymous figures and no leader is singled out
